giver: Ilse Varr, a stargazer and cartographer in Reece who has mapped every sky but this one, plus the voices met in the void: a ship's ghost, a stranded astronomer, an Enderman scribe
feel: Cold, quiet wonder after the fire of the Nether: a void of drifting islands, wrecked sky-ships and alien gardens; the danger is the fall, and the reward is flight

quests.title: The Island of Stone
quests.summary: Ilse begs for one thing before you jump: notes on the central island. Walk YUNG's rebuilt End island, count its towers and sketch the ruined arches before the dragon notices you.

quests.title: A Safe Landing
quests.summary: The void forgives nothing. Build a walled platform with a bed-free shelter, a waystone and an ender chest at the island's edge, out of the dragon's flight path.

quests.title: Breath in a Bottle
quests.summary: Ilse wants the dragon's breath for her ink. While the dragon's breath cloud hangs, fill five bottles in under a minute, then brew a lingering potion.

quests.title: Beyond the Gateway
quests.summary: With the dragon gone, the gateway portals open. Throw a pearl through one and reach the outer islands, then walk a thousand blocks of them.

quests.title: The Purple Towers
quests.summary: Find an End city and climb it to the top, clearing the shulkers that guard each floor.

quests.title: Shells for Boxes
quests.summary: Collect twelve shulker shells and craft two shulker boxes; keep the rest, because some eyes need them later.
quests.reward: Shulker box dyes, a sophisticated backpack upgrade

quests.title: The Wings on the Wall
quests.summary: An End ship hangs off a city's edge with wings in its hold. Take the elytra and wear it in your Elytra Slot, so your chestplate stays on.

quests.title: First Flight
quests.summary: Fly five kilometres with the elytra. Ilse asks for a sketch from the highest point you reach.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a stack of rockets

quests.title: The Chorus Garden
quests.summary: Harvest chorus fruit, replant flowers on end stone at your landing, and build a purpur lookout from popped chorus.

quests.title: The Wrecked Fleet
quests.summary: Huge ships, far bigger than any End ship, lie crashed across the islands. Find one of Moog's mega ships and reach its bridge.

quests.title: The Ship's Ghost
quests.summary: The wreck's captain lingers on the bridge and wants his logbook pages, scattered through the other crashed and deepslate mega ships, so he can learn why the fleet fell.

quests.title: The Starlight Voyager
quests.summary: The logbook names the fleet's flagship, the Starlight Voyager. Find it intact, and bring its navigation star back to the ghost to let him rest.
quests.reward: Magic XP, shulker shells, a navigator's compass

quests.title: The Phantom Citadel
quests.summary: A citadel that phantoms nest in, even here. Fight up its spires and clear the nests.

quests.title: The Enderkeep Courtyard
quests.summary: Hold the Enderkeep courtyard against waves of endermen and endermites for four minutes while its gate mechanism winds open.

quests.title: The Enderwatch
quests.summary: Climb an Enderwatch tower and, from the top, spot three more of Moog's End structures for Ilse's map.
quests.reward: An empty map and spyglass, Agility XP

quests.title: The Manuscript Shrine
quests.summary: An Enderman keeps a shrine of manuscripts and won't be looked at. Read the shrine's texts without meeting its gaze and answer the scribe's question to earn a page.

quests.title: The Mythic Garden
quests.summary: A walled garden of impossible plants grows on a far island. Bring back cuttings from the Mythic Garden and the Enderbloom Grove.

quests.title: The Fallen Star
quests.summary: A meteorite has struck an island, and a stranded astronomer camps in a hideaway nearby. Find the meteorite, then the astral hideaway, and hear what fell.

quests.title: The Ender Spire
quests.summary: The astronomer needs a reading from the top of the Ender Spire before the next 'star-fall'. Climb it in under three minutes, no elytra.

quests.title: The Monolith
quests.summary: A black monolith hums on a barren island. Align it with the astronomer's reading and the star that fell starts to make sense.

quests.title: Quiet Meadows
quests.summary: Find a placid prairie and an enderskog in the outer End, peaceful places where nothing tries to kill you, and rest there a full minute each.

quests.title: Void Wildlife
quests.summary: Ilse wants proof there's life here: bucket a cosmic cod, feed an endergrade chorus until it follows you, and bring back ender residue from an enderiophage.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a cosmic cod bucket

quests.title: Salvage the Scraps
quests.summary: Broken pillars, spikes and scrap heaps litter the islands. Sift three of them for the void's leftovers.

quests.title: Null Space
quests.summary: Beyond the cities the End gets stranger. Fly over Nullscape's crystal peaks, the shadowlands and the void barrens.

quests.title: Bones in the Dark
quests.summary: In the shadowlands lie the bones of a dragon far older than the one you killed. Find one and count its ribs: Ilse thinks there were many dragons once.
quests.reward: A dragon's bone (named trophy), Magic XP

quests.title: Strange Shores
quests.summary: Some islands are overgrown or rotten. Stand in Biomes O' Plenty's end wilds, end reef and end corruption, and bring a block back from each.

quests.title: The Lonely Tower
quests.summary: A Structory tower stands alone on an outer island. Climb it and bring Ilse the star map kept at its top.

quests.title: The Aviary
quests.summary: A colossal bird-cage of a dungeon floats in the End. Clear When Dungeons Arise's aviary and its keepers.

quests.title: Sky Pirates
quests.summary: An airship drifts through the void, crewed by illagers who think the End is empty. Board one and take its captain's chest.

quests.title: The Sealed Citadel
quests.summary: In the highlands stands a ruined citadel with a door that will not open while its guardian sleeps. Find Cataclysm's Ruined Citadel and note its Ender Golems; this one is for later.
quests.reward: A note on Ilse's chart, golden apples

quests.title: The Void Eye
quests.summary: The guardian woke with the others. Craft the Void Eye from shulker shells and an eye of ender, and give Ilse the finished chart of the End.
quests.reward: Ilse's Voidwalker boots (named, Feather Falling IV)
